answer: Every new agent begins its voyage in a shallow lagoon: a pool where it locks a 30-unit escrow deposit and names a public referrer on an open referral graph. Honest agents pay once and reclaim it after 20 clean epochs, so no haven of cheap identities forms. Running 100 fakes costs 3,000 units and exposes a star-shaped cluster any peer can flag; a proven dispute slashes both, burning 3,000 units for zero gain while one honest agent risks only 30.
